tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and this applies going forward. Testing in development is done with self-signed certificates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It has one paragraph saying TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development included, going forward. It adds that development testing uses self-signed certificates.

It rests on two recorded decisions, #30 ("Verification on all builds going forward") and #31 ("testing with self-signed certificates instead"). Each replaced an earlier decision. `muninn show` reports the replaced ones (#28 and #18) as retired and doesn't serve their content, so the doc doesn't mention them.

The retired #18 has no content I could read. #31's text only says "testing with self-signed certificates instead", so pairing it with verification being on is my reading of the two records together. The doc adds no other details.

The Muninn heartbeat also flagged 20 hook runs that started and never finished, which suggests a hook is timing out. I didn't investigate it.
